newsitem.title: ROMANIA: SOCCER-SIX-MONTH BABY NAMED PRESIDENT AND PLAYER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SIX-MONTH BABY NAMED PRESIDENT AND PLAYER.

text.p: The owner of a Romanian district soccer team has appointed his six-month-old son as club manager and player, a local newspaper reported on Monday.

Daily Sportul Romanesc said Aurel Rusu, owner of the Sadcom soccer team in the eastern village of Caragele wanted his son Lucian to become "a great soccer player so I decided to introduce him early into sports".
Sadcom play in the Vrancea county's lowest championship.
